title: Give thanks for the meeting that broke the inner crowd
summary: The body-village crowded by desire and anger is broken open by meeting the Holy Saint. Your turning toward the Guru is already grace at work, not evidence of your private strength.
takeaway: Honor the grace that brought you into the Guru's love.
lifeApplication: When pride appears after a steadier day, remember who broke the crowd inside. Bow inwardly, thank the Guru for the meeting, and let gratitude keep the next choice humble.

source.shortMeaning: Desire and anger crowd the body-village until meeting the Holy Saint breaks them apart and grace brings the mind into the Lord's love.
source.lifeApplication: Treat every real turning toward the Guru as grace already written, and answer it with humility rather than self-credit.

evidence.coreClaim: The inner crowd is broken by holy meeting and pre-written grace; love begins where the soul stops claiming its own rescue.
evidence.turn: Give thanks for the Guru-meeting that made your turning possible before pride names it personal strength.
evidence.practicalImplication: When pride appears after a steadier day, remember who broke the crowd inside. Bow inwardly, thank the Guru for the meeting, and let gratitude keep the next choice humble.
